name: Movie Poster Wall
description: WebGL wall of tilted movie and TV posters pulled from TMDB that drifts upward on its own and speeds up on mouse wheel, with a large centered logo overlay.
contents: Three.js canvas with a grid of rounded poster meshes in tilted perspective
Centered logo text with optional subtext overlay
behavior: Posters are fetched from TMDB and cached in localStorage, shuffled each load
Wall scrolls upward automatically and loops by recycling rows
Mouse wheel over the component advances the wall instead of scrolling the page
Canvas resizes with the window width
editableByProps: Logo text, subtext, font, color, size, spacing and visibility
Grid size, poster dimensions, spacing and corner radius
Camera angle, field of view, light, scroll speeds and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a different poster source than TMDB
needsCodeEdit.where: fetchAssetList and renderPosters functions inside the useEffect
textShadow in the logo span style

fixed: Requires network access to the TMDB API and image CDN and uses localStorage for caching
Mouse wheel over the component is captured with preventDefault, so the page does not scroll while hovering it
Canvas is sized to window width at a fixed aspect ratio and pinned to the bottom of a full-viewport container
Ships with a default TMDB API key that should be replaced with your own
